```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("stock_functions.R")
library(knitr)
```

# Load the portfolio

```{r load, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
names(stocks)
```

# Display each stock

```{r display, results='asis'}
# Custom display utility: header, first and last rows, summary
display_stock <- function(sym, df) {
  cat("\n\n## ", sym, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Rows:** ", nrow(df), " | **From:** ", format(min(df$Date)),
      " | **To:** ", format(max(df$Date)), "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(kable(head(df, 5), digits = 2, caption = paste(sym, "first 5 rows")))
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(tail(df, 5), digits = 2, caption = paste(sym, "last 5 rows")))
  cat("\n\n")
}
for (sym in names(stocks)) display_stock(sym, stocks[[sym]])
```

# Calculated statistics

```{r stats}
stats <- calculate_all_statistics(stocks, ma_window = 20)
kable(stats, digits = 2, caption = "Close price statistics (20 day moving average)")
```

# Visualizations

## Close price with moving average

```{r plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (sym in names(stocks)) {
  df <- stocks[[sym]]
  plot(df$Date, df$Close, type = "l", col = "steelblue",
       xlab = "Date", ylab = "Close price", main = paste(sym, "Close with 20 day MA"))
  lines(df$Date, moving_average(df, 20), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("Close", "20 day MA"),
         col = c("steelblue", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
}
```

## Candlestick view (quantmod)

```{r candles, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
for (sym in names(stocks)) {
  df <- stocks[[sym]]
  x <- xts::xts(df[, c("Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume", "Adjusted")], order.by = df$Date)
  chartSeries(tail(x, 90), name = sym, theme = chartTheme("white"), TA = "addSMA(20)")
}
```

## Mean comparison

```{r bar, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
barplot(stats$Mean, names.arg = stats$Symbol, col = "steelblue",
        ylab = "Mean close price", main = "Mean close by stock")
```
